scope: Fixed consumed-Dev mechanism diagnostic only; no generalization, SOTA, or leaderboard claim.

model_usage.accounting_note: Generation usage only across recorded M3 attempts with available usage; infrastructure retries and external evaluation costs are reported in position artifacts where available.

main_contradiction: Restarting a completed strong-Agent session with one exact target payload occasionally repairs a known failure, but it does not accumulate a reusable deployment capability across future environments and does not address the dominant operation-selection failures.
strongest_support: Position 16 produced one valid T-exclusive Official recovery for Git safe-directory ownership. Together with M2, exact target feedback has two strict gains, both in the same Git-ownership family.
strongest_counterevidence: M3 produced only three valid matched opportunities, below the preregistered minimum of four for generalization.
At positions 2 and 5, both typed-null control and real-feedback branches passed after transient acquisition failures, so the real payload was not the causal difference.
The strict gains remained confined to Git ownership; no non-Git failure family satisfied the preregistered generalization rule.
Positions 19, 20, 23, and 24 exposed operation-level failures where static import success diverged from executable dependency completeness.
Positions 21 and 22 showed boundary false positives: legitimate upstream-source extraction and local configuration passed auxiliary Official despite primary rejection.

decision.reason: The study measured local repair value but did not establish cross-deployment learning. More one-shot cases or verifier variants would not answer the core question.

next_highest_information_experiment: Run the preregistered same-project sequence comparing P_t plus the same strong-Agent fallback against latest-static-program reuse plus the same fallback. Require P_t updates to pass current and historical public clean replays, and evaluate whether a later fresh condition retains Official success with less new exploration after full lifecycle accounting.
